card.description: Houseplants described by what you can see: spots on the leaves, leaf colour, whether the plant droops, and how the soil feels. The goal is to predict whether the plant is healthy or sick.
card.source: Made for the Sprite Lab 2 plant example.

context.potentialUses: Learn which visible signs tell you a houseplant needs help.
context.potentialMisuses: It is not a real botanical survey. Every combination appears exactly once, so it is tidier than data collected from real plants.

fields.description: Dark spots on the leaves: none, few, or many.
The overall colour of the leaves: green, pale, or yellow.
Whether the leaves and stems hang down: no or yes.
How the soil feels to a finger: dry, damp, or wet.
Whether the plant is Healthy or Sick.
